entry_points.text: Getgroups reports count and optionally copies the set; negative, undersized non-zero and copy faults fail distinctly, zero only queries. Setgroups lets privileged callers replace the set with a sorted import bounded by maximum.

Detect-count reads the atomic counter and only zero clears it. Timeout and interval use the unsigned-long vector handler where available else report unimplemented, waking the supervisor after successful writes.

Compiler hooks record return addresses and integer comparison operands when matching tracing is active; width and constant-aware variants share a recorder, and switches expand into repeated records with size-derived typing.

File operations wire open, control, mapping and release; init creates a privileged debug entry and seeds one interrupt-safe pool area per processor, failing if any allocation fails, optionally running a timer-spinning self check.

exports.text: Map a physical range trying write-back then write-through then write-combining; empty, mixed RAM overlap and incompatible alias fail, latter two warning. Managed variant binds success to the device and warns when explicit release finds no match.

Startup records panic entry, suspends scanning across suspend and restore preparation until completion, starts the supervisor, publishes controls where supported, and honors a one-shot skip of the next due scan.

Per-CPU deferred work offers pending query, prompt drain from interrupt or tick, and wait for one item. Pending clear makes an item reusable; busy clears absent a rival claimant, with queue wakeup or brief spin by build and uninterruptible wait plus grace period.

Cross-task identity comparison by namespace identifiers and type covers files, address spaces, tables, filesystem, signal, IO, semaphore undo where built, and epoll membership; unknown types and unsupported builds fail distinctly.

Coverage device offers open, exact-range mapping, control and close. Open creates a disabled object with unit reference; control validates sizes, modes and handles first. Remote start attaches a buffer after validation and stop detaches and merges.

Image lifecycle validates descriptors, allocates a zeroed object with linked cursors and empty page sets, loads segments by index via normal or crash helpers, terminates the chain, and frees by chain walk plus machine cleanup. Fresh objects use an all-ones sentinel for no control page.

hazards.text: Mixed RAM mapping and incompatible-cache aliasing warn; hung reporting stops after budget expires and a round meeting the panic threshold forces panic.

Offline with queued work warns; bad sizes, offsets, uninitialized control, double use, reserved fields, excess handles and copy mismatches fail unchanged, with one warning on page failure. Sleepable start may allocate on pool exhaustion.
Concurrent loads fail busy; uninstall exchanges null and frees the old image with crash protection removed then restored as needed.

invariants.text: Group replacement uses prepare, mutate, security check, then commit or abort; permission, size, allocation and import errors leave state unchanged. Permission needs setgid capability plus namespace allowance with GID mapping and explicit flag.

A scan finding hung threads bumps global and round counts, reports while budget remains or panic is armed, consumes budget, refreshes info, and panics at threshold; scans skip after fatal taint or prior panic. Blocker diagnosis matches owners against live threads.

Write-back RAM requests first reuse a valid low direct mapping when allowed, else use architecture mapping preferring cached. Overlap is disjoint, intersecting, or mixed; type match needs all flag bits plus wildcard or exact descriptor, including split descendants.

Compared addresses never leave raw; each mixes with a per-type secret pair seeded once with forced oddness and high bit, then orders three-valued. Targets resolve with references; missing tasks, ptrace denial, bad descriptors and user faults fail distinctly.

Handles authenticate by subsystem and instance masks; duplicates and allocation failures fail distinctly and areas match by exact length and class. Buffers use leading count plus payload, drop overflow silently, and publish count before payload for reentrant records.

A mode is enabled when value ignoring the context-switch flag differs from disabled. Tasks use remote-sized shareable pools, soft interrupts use fixed safe pools with cleared counts. Stop merges only on sequence match with owner still remote; area always returns and the reference drops.

Descriptors need aligned non-wrapping ranges below the limit, pairwise disjointness, buffered within memory size, and page totals within half of memory; crash images must sit inside the reservation. Allocation marks crash type and reserves control and swap pages, unwinding on failure.

Release walks the chain freeing prior indirection on meeting a new one and source pages directly, plus destination sets, metadata, machine state and contiguous blocks. File cleanup releases image, filesystem, command line, purgatory, headers and measurement, nulling pointers.

locks.text: Allowance and flags read under a dedicated mutex for a consistent snapshot; group count reads are lockless because the referenced credential state is stable for the reader.
Iteration holds RCU with a time break that pins process and thread, drops RCU, yields, reacquires, and continues only if both survive; visited entries are bounded by a tunable.
Overlap inspection runs under a resource read lock; atomic notifier registration serializes chain mutation with interrupt-saving spin locking.
Both targets hold execution-update read locks during inspection; acquisition orders by address with killable waits, treats identical locks singly, and releases in complementary order.
Classic draining assumes disabled interrupts with atomic handover; thread lazy draining adds read-side protection, and waiting pairs queue wakeup with a grace period for safe reclamation.

The instance lock with interrupt save serializes mode, buffer, mapping and local enable work; the table lock serializes handle and pool handling without nesting the instance lock, and merging runs under the owner lock.

state_machines.text: A thread counts hung only in uninterruptible sleep without killable, no-load or frozen qualifiers, having switched once, with no recent progress and last switch older than the timeout.

A supervisor sleeps until a deadline from the smaller of timeout and interval, defaulting interval to timeout when zero; zero timeout disables scanning, and reset requests or power suspension skip scans.
Lazy work uses per-CPU raised and deferred queues plus a worker; wakeup fires only when deferred work pends and the worker exists, and the should-run predicate reflects pending deferred work.

Lazy draining joins raised work classically but delegates to a low-priority per-CPU FIFO thread under full preemption, draining only the lazy list; the thread registers once during early init in those builds.

Coverage moves disabled to initialized after buffer setup, then to counter or comparison tracing after enable, returning to disabled on disable or exit; remote enable also records sizing and handles and marks remote collection.

Loading serializes with a try lock, selects crash or normal destination, treats zero segments as uninstall, clears prior crash state for panic images, then allocates, prepares machine state, loads segments, terminates, exchanges into place and frees the old image.

structs.text: Controls publish backtrace, panic threshold, check count, timeout, interval, warnings, detect count and info mask with range handlers; timeout and interval share a maximum and backtrace exists only on multiprocessor. Interval zero follows timeout; warnings start at ten.

Remote tracking uses handle entries with hash linkage, reusable areas with list linkage and length, two free lists split by interrupt context, a global table lock, and per-CPU local locking; the central object holds reference, mode, length, buffer, owner, remote flag and sequence.

Task state holds mode, size, area, sequence, object, soft-interrupt mark and handle plus saved copies; entry preserves the interrupted session and halts collection, exit clears the mark, reattaches the saved session and clears saved fields.
